commentary_title: Aframax market remains steady, buoyed by demand from the Med
commentary_summary: The Aframax tonne-miles index showed a slight improvement in week 7, ending the week at 87.5 points. There was fairly limited activity in the market, especially in the UKC and the Mediterranean regions. While the Mediterranean region had a good start to the week, low cargo availability eventually dulled the tonnage demand, but the initial firmness pushed up rates in the region. | In the UKC, rates remained firm, but with more vessels moving outwards, freight rates could strengthen next week. While the global ballast speed saw a decline, the laden speed continued to rise. The Aframax market is likely to see an improvement in utilisation next week.
